issue: Original label missing_inline_citation could overpenalize the official final-References response convention.
clarification: When the answer clearly names publication and Claim and its final References correctly resolve to supporting sources, do not score absent numbered per-sentence footnotes as a citation error. Record lack of structured statement-to-span anchors separately as granularity limitation. Actual wrong/unresolvable citation mappings remain errors.
rationale: The user requests accurate source/Claim support, and the official answer prompt explicitly asks a final References section; per-sentence numbered footnotes were not a required user constraint.
apply_consistently: Apply to every smoke and full-query answer in both modes, not selected cases.
